english.title: Fail to comply with duty to find out about persons ceasing to be PSCs
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were

(A)_[a company]_
(B)_[an officer of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..),]_

to which Part 21A of the Companies Act 2006 applied and which knew or had cause to believe that a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), has ceased to be a registrable

(C)_[person,]_
(D)_[relevant legal entity,]_

in relation to the company but had not had confirmation that the person had so ceased or the date on which that person had done so and

(E)_[failed]_
(F)_[which was in default by failing]_

without reasonable excuse to, within the required time limits, comply with the duty under section 790EA of the Act to give that person a notice requiring

(G)_[him]_
(H)_[her]_
(I)_[it]_

to inform the company whether

(J)_[he]_
(K)_[she]_
(L)_[it]_

had ceased to be a registrable

(M)_[person]_
(N)_[relevant legal entity]_

in relation to the company, and if that person had, to inform the company of the date of that cessation
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 790EA and 790F of the Companies Act 2006.
